guide.tagline: Find the right Edith command by describing what you want to do.
guide.summary: A searchable, offline reference for every ed command. Type a goal in plain words and Docs ranks the commands that fit. Nothing you read here changes your settings or your machine.

steps.title: Describe your goal
steps.detail: Type something like "free up docker space" in the ask bar at the top, or press Command K.

steps.title: Pick a match
steps.detail: Use the arrow keys to move through the ranked commands and press Return to open one.

steps.title: Read the page
steps.detail: Every page explains the command, shows examples, and links to related commands.

steps.title: Browse or filter
steps.detail: Use the list on the left, or press Command F to filter pages by name.

examples: ed docs ask "restart the background agent"
